parameters.content:
## Setup before activation
1. Select the same Header Auth credential on all Grocy nodes: header GROCY-API-KEY. Grocy URL: https://grocy.ggarcia24.site. Currency must be EUR.
2. Select a Basic Auth credential on Manual mapping approval. Approval links go to the existing private ntfy purchases topic. No AI is used. Run import_grocy_products.py to populate existing-product choices.
3. Run edeka-product-creation.sql once in grocy_import as the table owner/admin before using Create. It creates the barcode-keyed creation log and grants grocy_importer access. Existing tables products, receipt_aliases, receipts and receipt_lines also need SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE and identity-sequence USAGE/SELECT for the n8n role. No schema changes run automatically.
4. Review the pinned examples and select credentials before activating this inactive export.

## Approval actions
Map selects an existing catalog product. Create selects an OFF candidate with a barcode and name, creates the Grocy product/barcode and caches it before saving the alias. Ignore records a skipped receipt line without stock changes. Fill only the corresponding selector. Mapping/creation always requires an explicit receipt-to-stock conversion.
New-product defaults are in Prepare manual approval: Pantry location 3, Pack stock/purchase unit 3, seven best-before days. OFF package size is descriptive, not an inferred conversion.

## Safety and operations
Each PDF is parsed separately and its normalized full text is SHA-256 hashed for receipt identity, including forwarded copies. The product loop serializes approvals and the hidden receipt key prevents stale submissions applying to a different line. Deposits/discounts are not stock additions.
Before purchase, live Grocy currency, product, stock unit and tare handling are checked. Best-before defaults are relative to import day; -1 means never expires. Tare products require manual processing.
A unique barcode creation log is committed before creation POSTs. Uncertain creations never retry automatically. A product may exist even when barcode registration failed: inspect receipt_product_creations and Grocy, then reconcile deliberately; never create a second product blindly.
An atomic receipt-line claim precedes the single stock POST. Imported/skipped lines are not resent. Sending/uncertain/failed imports require reconciliation against the stock log using the import key in the stock note. Never retry creation, barcode or purchase nodes directly after a timeout.
Edited receipt text can change its fingerprint; check previous imports before processing altered receipts.

nodes.name: Prepare product lookup
nodes.notes: Validates parsed stock products and amounts before the parameterized mapping lookup. Does not guess missing quantities or weight units.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item
)
SELECT
    i.receipt_item,
    COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'product_id', p.id::text,
                'alias_id', a.id::text,
                'barcode', p.barcode,
                'product_name', p.name,
                'grocy_product_id', p.grocy_product_id::text,
                'grocy_stock_unit_id', a.grocy_stock_unit_id::text,
                'conversion_factor', a.stock_units_per_receipt_unit::text,
                'stock_quantity', (
                    (i.receipt_item->>'receipt_quantity')::numeric
                    * a.stock_units_per_receipt_unit
                )::text,
                'price_per_stock_unit', (
                    ((i.receipt_item->>'net_line_total_minor')::numeric / 100)
                    / NULLIF(
                        (i.receipt_item->>'receipt_quantity')::numeric
                        * a.stock_units_per_receipt_unit,
                        0
                    )
                )::text
            )
            ORDER BY a.id
        )
        FROM public.receipt_aliases AS a
        JOIN public.products AS p ON p.id = a.product_id
        WHERE a.retailer_key = i.receipt_item->>'retailer_key'
          AND a.normalized_description = i.receipt_item->>'normalized_description'
          AND a.receipt_unit = i.receipt_item->>'receipt_unit'
          AND a.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS mapping_candidates
FROM incoming AS i;

nodes.name: Postgres - look up confirmed mapping
nodes.notes: READ ONLY. Uses public.products and public.receipt_aliases from the suggested schema. Always returns one row per input, including a cache miss. Values are bound as one JSONB parameter, not interpolated into SQL.

nodes.name: Resolve mapping result
nodes.notes: Preserves the original product and adds mapping_candidates, mapping_status and mapping_ready. Amounts/conversions calculated with PostgreSQL NUMERIC remain decimal strings. Verify the expected stock unit against Grocy before any stock write.

parameters.query: SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product_id', p.id::text, 'product_name', p.name, 'barcode', p.barcode, 'grocy_product_id', p.grocy_product_id::text, 'grocy_stock_unit_id', p.metadata->'grocy'->>'qu_id_stock') ORDER BY p.name, p.id) FROM public.products AS p), '[]'::jsonb) AS approval_products;

nodes.name: Load approval catalog
nodes.notes: Loads existing catalog choices for manual approval. No AI or inferred conversions. Stock-unit metadata comes from the catalog importer or the approved creation path and is verified against live Grocy before purchase.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({product: $json.product_name, source_key: $json.source_key, line_number: $json.line_number, import_key: $json.import_key, reason: $json.mapping_reason, mapping_candidates: $json.mapping_candidates, import_status: $json.import_status, creation_barcode: $json.new_product?.barcode, created_grocy_product_id: $json.new_grocy_product_id}, null, 2) }}

nodes.name: Notify mapping or import review
nodes.notes: Notifies the existing private ntfy topic. No automatic selection, retry or stock addition occurs on this branch.

nodes.name: SAVE ENTRY - validate approved mapping
nodes.notes: Receives only explicitly approved form submissions. Validates the selected existing catalog product and conversion before saving. Does not create products in Grocy.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item
),
existing_product AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.name, p.barcode, p.grocy_product_id
    FROM public.products AS p
    CROSS JOIN incoming AS i
    WHERE p.id = (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'product_id')::bigint
      AND p.grocy_product_id =
          (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'grocy_product_id')::bigint
      AND (
          i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'barcode' IS NULL
          OR p.barcode = i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'barcode'
      )
),
new_product AS (
    INSERT INTO public.products AS stored (
        barcode, name, package_quantity, package_unit, grocy_product_id, metadata
    )
    SELECT
        i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'barcode',
        i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'product_name',
        (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'package_quantity')::numeric,
        i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'package_unit',
        (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'grocy_product_id')::bigint,
        NULLIF(i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->'metadata', 'null'::jsonb)
    FROM incoming AS i
    WHERE i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'product_id' IS NULL
    ON CONFLICT (barcode) DO UPDATE
        SET barcode = EXCLUDED.barcode
        WHERE stored.grocy_product_id = EXCLUDED.grocy_product_id
    RETURNING id, name, barcode, grocy_product_id
),
chosen_product AS (
    SELECT id, name, barcode, grocy_product_id FROM existing_product
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, name, barcode, grocy_product_id FROM new_product
),
saved_alias AS (
    INSERT INTO public.receipt_aliases (
        retailer_key, normalized_description, product_id, receipt_unit,
        grocy_stock_unit_id, stock_units_per_receipt_unit, confirmed_at
    )
    SELECT
        i.receipt_item->>'retailer_key',
        i.receipt_item->>'normalized_description',
        p.id,
        i.receipt_item->>'receipt_unit',
        (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'grocy_stock_unit_id')::bigint,
        (i.receipt_item->'approved_mapping'->>'stock_units_per_receipt_unit')::numeric,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    FROM incoming AS i
    CROSS JOIN chosen_product AS p
    WHERE TRUE
    ON CONFLICT (retailer_key, normalized_description, receipt_unit, product_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        grocy_stock_unit_id = EXCLUDED.grocy_stock_unit_id,
        stock_units_per_receipt_unit = EXCLUDED.stock_units_per_receipt_unit,
        confirmed_at = EXCLUDED.confirmed_at
    RETURNING id, product_id, grocy_stock_unit_id, stock_units_per_receipt_unit
)
SELECT
    i.receipt_item,
    (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'product_id', p.id::text,
            'alias_id', a.id::text,
            'barcode', p.barcode,
            'product_name', p.name,
            'grocy_product_id', p.grocy_product_id::text,
            'grocy_stock_unit_id', a.grocy_stock_unit_id::text,
            'conversion_factor', a.stock_units_per_receipt_unit::text
        )
        FROM saved_alias AS a
        JOIN chosen_product AS p ON p.id = a.product_id
    ) AS saved_mapping
FROM incoming AS i;

nodes.name: Postgres - save confirmed mapping
nodes.notes: WRITES only public.products/receipt_aliases in one atomic SQL statement. Repeated saves reuse the product/alias. Never reassigns an existing barcode to a different Grocy product. Does not delete alternative aliases; ambiguous labels remain review-only.

nodes.name: Verify saved mapping
nodes.notes: Fails explicitly on a conflicting/nonexistent product. On success, runs the normal lookup again; only a uniquely resolved mapping reaches live Grocy validation and the atomic import claim.

nodes.name: Parse EDEKA receipts
nodes.notes: Input: full extracted PDF text in json.text, one item per PDF. Output: one receipt with products, adjustments and parse_issues. No database or Grocy writes. Item counts and weight are not package-size conversions.

nodes.name: Notify receipt review
nodes.notes: Sends parsing issues to the existing private ntfy topic. The entire affected receipt is withheld from automatic purchases.

nodes.name: Prepare receipt products
nodes.notes: Flattens registered receipts to individual products, preserving stable receipt and line import keys. Deposits and discounts remain in the receipt output; product net totals include attached discounts.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), registered AS (
  INSERT INTO public.receipts (retailer_key, source_key, receipt_fingerprint, currency)
  SELECT 'edeka', 'edeka:sha256:' || (receipt_item->>'receipt_fingerprint'), receipt_item->>'receipt_fingerprint', 'EUR' FROM incoming
  ON CONFLICT (receipt_fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET receipt_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.receipt_fingerprint
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, r.id::text AS receipt_id FROM incoming AS i CROSS JOIN registered AS r;

SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item, (SELECT l.import_status FROM public.receipt_lines AS l WHERE l.receipt_id = ($1::jsonb->>'receipt_id')::bigint AND l.line_number = ($1::jsonb->>'line_number')::integer) AS existing_import_status;

Create from OFF suggestion and purchase

nodes.name: Manual mapping approval
nodes.notes: Select a Basic Auth credential before activation. Field and option arrays must stay literal: n8n imports array expressions as blank entries. Only scalar field values/options use expressions. The native form shows ten catalog products per page and five OFF suggestion slots. Latest-page references (-1) and hidden receipt/revision keys protect serialized approvals. Respond to approval acknowledges decisions or lets the native browser poll for a new page. No client-supplied receipt or Grocy IDs are trusted.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), skipped AS (
  INSERT INTO public.receipt_lines (receipt_id, line_number, raw_description, line_kind, receipt_quantity, receipt_unit, line_total_minor, import_key, import_status)
  SELECT (r->>'receipt_id')::bigint, (r->>'line_number')::integer, r->>'raw_description', 'product', (r->>'receipt_quantity')::numeric, r->>'receipt_unit', (r->>'line_total_minor')::bigint, r->>'import_key', 'skipped'
  FROM incoming CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receipt_item AS r) AS row
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skipped) AS skipped,
  (SELECT l.import_status FROM public.receipt_lines AS l WHERE l.receipt_id = (i.receipt_item->>'receipt_id')::bigint AND l.line_number = (i.receipt_item->>'line_number')::integer) AS existing_import_status
FROM incoming AS i;

WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO public.receipt_lines (receipt_id, line_number, raw_description, line_kind, product_id, alias_id, receipt_quantity, receipt_unit, line_total_minor, grocy_product_id, grocy_stock_unit_id, conversion_factor, stock_quantity, import_key, import_status)
  SELECT (r->>'receipt_id')::bigint, (r->>'line_number')::integer, r->>'raw_description', 'product', (r->>'product_id')::bigint, (r->>'alias_id')::bigint, (r->>'receipt_quantity')::numeric, r->>'receipt_unit', (r->>'line_total_minor')::bigint, (r->>'grocy_product_id')::bigint, (r->>'grocy_stock_unit_id')::bigint, (r->>'conversion_factor')::numeric, (r->>'stock_quantity')::numeric, r->>'import_key', 'sending'
  FROM incoming CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receipt_item AS r) AS row
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, c.id::text AS receipt_line_id, c.id IS NOT NULL AS import_claimed,
  (SELECT l.import_status FROM public.receipt_lines AS l WHERE l.receipt_id = (i.receipt_item->>'receipt_id')::bigint AND l.line_number = (i.receipt_item->>'line_number')::integer) AS existing_import_status
FROM incoming AS i LEFT JOIN claimed AS c ON TRUE;

nodes.name: Postgres - claim receipt line
nodes.notes: Atomic insert with unique receipt-line/import keys. Only the execution that inserted sending may POST to Grocy. Conflicts never update or reclaim an existing line, including sending/uncertain rows. A concurrent commit may be invisible to this statement's snapshot; that becomes review, never a second claim.

nodes.name: Grocy - purchase once
nodes.notes: Single non-retrying POST, only after the persistent sending claim. Transport errors and unexpected responses continue to outcome tracking as uncertain. Never manually retry this node: check the stock note/import key in Grocy first.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), recorded AS (
  UPDATE public.receipt_lines AS l SET import_status = r->>'import_status', grocy_response = r->'grocy_response', last_error = r->>'mapping_reason', imported_at = CASE WHEN r->>'import_status' = 'imported' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END
  FROM incoming CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receipt_item AS r) AS row
  WHERE l.id = (r->>'receipt_line_id')::bigint AND l.import_key = r->>'import_key' AND l.import_status = 'sending' AND r->>'import_status' IN ('imported', 'uncertain')
  RETURNING l.id
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS outcome_recorded FROM incoming AS i;

WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO public.receipt_product_creations (barcode, import_key, product_name, request_body, creation_status)
  SELECT r->'new_product'->>'barcode', r->>'import_key', r->'new_product'->>'name', r->'creation_body', 'sending_product'
  FROM incoming CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receipt_item AS r) AS row
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products AS p WHERE p.barcode = r->'new_product'->>'barcode')
  ON CONFLICT (barcode) DO NOTHING RETURNING barcode
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed) AS creation_claimed,
  (SELECT c.creation_status FROM public.receipt_product_creations AS c WHERE c.barcode = i.receipt_item->'new_product'->>'barcode') AS existing_creation_status,
  (SELECT p.grocy_product_id::text FROM public.products AS p WHERE p.barcode = i.receipt_item->'new_product'->>'barcode') AS existing_grocy_product_id
FROM incoming AS i;

nodes.name: Postgres - claim product creation
nodes.notes: Requires edeka-product-creation.sql once. A unique barcode claim is committed before either Grocy creation POST. Existing, pending or uncertain creations are never reclaimed automatically.

nodes.name: Grocy - create product once
nodes.notes: Non-retrying creation POST after the barcode claim. Do not retry this node directly; timeouts may leave a real product in Grocy.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), recorded AS (
  UPDATE public.receipt_product_creations AS c
  SET creation_status = r->>'creation_status', grocy_product_id = (r->>'new_grocy_product_id')::bigint,
      grocy_response = jsonb_build_object('product', r->'creation_response'), last_error = r->>'mapping_reason', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FROM incoming CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receipt_item AS r) AS row
  WHERE c.barcode = r->'new_product'->>'barcode' AND c.import_key = r->>'import_key'
    AND c.creation_status = 'sending_product' AND r->>'creation_status' IN ('sending_barcode', 'uncertain')
  RETURNING c.barcode
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS outcome_recorded FROM incoming AS i;

WITH incoming AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS receipt_item), eligible AS (
  SELECT i.receipt_item AS r FROM incoming AS i JOIN public.receipt_product_creations AS c
    ON c.barcode = i.receipt_item->'new_product'->>'barcode' AND c.import_key = i.receipt_item->>'import_key'
    AND c.creation_status = 'sending_barcode' AND c.grocy_product_id = (i.receipt_item->>'new_grocy_product_id')::bigint
), catalog_product AS (
  INSERT INTO public.products AS stored (barcode, name, grocy_product_id, metadata)
  SELECT r->'new_product'->>'barcode', r->'new_product'->>'name', (r->>'new_grocy_product_id')::bigint,
    jsonb_build_object('grocy', jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', r->>'new_grocy_product_id', 'name', r->'new_product'->>'name',
      'qu_id_stock', r->'new_product'->'qu_id_stock', 'qu_id_purchase', r->'new_product'->'qu_id_purchase',
      'location_id', r->'new_product'->'location_id', 'default_best_before_days', r->'new_product'->'default_best_before_days',
      'enable_tare_weight_handling', 0), 'openfoodfacts', jsonb_build_object(
      'code', r->'new_product'->>'barcode', 'brands', r->'new_product'->>'brands', 'quantity', r->'new_product'->>'package_description'))
  FROM eligible WHERE r->>'creation_status' = 'created'
  ON CONFLICT (barcode) DO UPDATE SET metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
    WHERE stored.grocy_product_id = EXCLUDED.grocy_product_id
  RETURNING id
), recorded AS (
  UPDATE public.receipt_product_creations AS c SET
    creation_status = CASE WHEN r->>'creation_status' = 'created' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_product) THEN 'created' ELSE 'uncertain' END,
    grocy_barcode_id = (r->>'new_grocy_barcode_id')::bigint,
    grocy_response = c.grocy_response || jsonb_build_object('barcode', r->'barcode_response'),
    last_error = CASE WHEN r->>'creation_status' = 'created' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_product)
      THEN 'Catalog barcode conflict after Grocy product creation. Reconcile; do not create another product.' ELSE r->>'mapping_reason' END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  FROM eligible WHERE c.barcode = r->'new_product'->>'barcode' AND c.import_key = r->>'import_key'
  RETURNING c.creation_status, c.last_error
)
SELECT i.receipt_item, (SELECT id::text FROM catalog_product) AS catalog_product_id,
  (SELECT creation_status FROM recorded) AS recorded_creation_status, (SELECT last_error FROM recorded) AS creation_error,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS outcome_recorded FROM incoming AS i;
